column3: n. 纺纱;纺丝
column5: The museum lets children try the old spinning wheel every weekend.
column6: 博物馆每逢周末让孩子们体验古老的纺车。

column3: vt. 违反, 触犯, 否认, 反驳, 抵触, 与...冲突;触法, 违反, 否定
column5: The new advertising campaign could contravene consumer protection rules in several countries.
column6: 新广告活动可能违反多个国家的消费者保护条例。

column3: a. 友善的, 友好的;友好的, 和睦的, 温和的
column5: Despite the divorce, the couple maintained an amicable relationship for the children.
column6: 尽管离婚,两人为了孩子仍保持友好关系。

column3: a. 兴奋性的, 激励的, 鼓舞的;n. 兴奋剂, 酒精饮料
column5: Coffee acts as a mild stimulant that many adults rely on daily.
column6: 咖啡是一种温和的兴奋剂,许多成年人每天都离不开。

column3: n. 想像, 推测, 推想;假定, 推定, 推测
column5: The report rests on the supposition that housing prices will keep rising.
column6: 这份报告建立在房价将持续上涨的假定之上。

column3: a. 好问的, 想知道的, 好追根究底的
column5: The inquisitive child asked why the moon changes shape throughout the month.
column6: 好奇的孩子问月亮为什么在一个月里会变形。

column3: a. 不连贯的, 语无伦次的;不连贯的
column5: The witness grew incoherent under pressure and could not finish her account.
column6: 证人压力之下语无伦次,没能讲完经过。

column3: a. 不断的, 不绝的, 无尽的
column5: The incessant drilling next door made afternoon naps nearly impossible.
column6: 隔壁钻墙的噪音没完没了,午睡几乎不可能。

column3: vi. 挣扎, 折腾；错乱地做事或说话
column5: Startups often flounder when they expand faster than their cash flow allows.
column6: 初创公司扩张速度超过现金流承受力时常陷入挣扎。

column3: n. 不敬, 失礼, 无礼
column5: Texting during the ceremony was seen as disrespect toward the speakers.
column6: 典礼期间发短信被视为对演讲者的不尊重。

column3: v. 喷出, 溅迸, 注射;n. 水枪, 注射器, 喷出
column5: The kids would squirt water at each other with old plastic bottles.
column6: 孩子们用旧塑料瓶互相喷水玩。

column3: a. 兄弟的, 兄弟似的, 友爱的
column5: The fraternal twins look so different that strangers assume they are cousins.
column6: 这对异卵双胞胎长得太不像,陌生人以为是表亲。

column3: n. 讽刺, 暗讽;vi. 说讽刺话
column5: The article relied on innuendo rather than verified facts, critics complained.
column6: 批评者指出,这篇文章全靠含沙射影而非确凿事实。

column3: a. 感觉上的, 使感官以快感的, 敏感的
column5: The novel's sensuous descriptions of food make every chapter feel like a feast.
column6: 小说对食物的感官描写让每章读来都像一场盛宴。

column3: n. 自然发生, 自生, 自发
column5: The jazz trio's spontaneity keeps even familiar standards feeling fresh each night.
column6: 爵士三重奏的即兴发挥让熟悉的曲目每晚都透着新意。

column3: a. 好笑的, 滑稽的
column5: The meeting turned comical when two people presented the exact same proposal.
column6: 当两人提交了完全相同的方案时,会议变得滑稽起来。

column3: vt. 掩饰, 与...不符, 使失望
column5: Her cheerful tone belied the exhaustion she felt after the double shift.
column6: 她欢快的语气掩饰了连上两个班次后的疲惫。

column3: a. 英勇的;n. 勇敢的人
column5: The firefighters made a valiant effort to save the historic barn.
column6: 消防员为保住那座历史谷仓进行了英勇的抢救。

column3: vt. 不断打扰, 纠缠
column5: Reporters would pester the young star with questions about her private life.
column6: 记者们就私人问题频频纠缠这位年轻明星。

column3: n. 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯;升降阶梯
column5: The department store's escalator stopped mid-ride, stranding shoppers between floors.
column6: 商场的自动扶梯中途停运,顾客被卡在两层楼之间。

column3: n. 羞怯, 胆怯
column5: Her shyness melted away once the workshop turned to familiar design topics.
column6: 研讨会一转到熟悉的设计话题,她的羞怯便消失了。

column3: vt. 奴役, 束缚, 使受控制, 征服
column5: The regime tried to enslave conquered populations through forced labor contracts.
column6: 该政权试图通过强制劳动契约奴役被征服的民众。

column3: a. 有方法的, 有系统的
column5: His methodical approach to backups saved the firm during the ransomware attack.
column6: 他有条不紊的备份方法让公司在勒索软件攻击中幸免。

column3: vt. 使恼怒, 激怒, 恶化;a. 糙面的, 恼怒的, 激怒的
column5: Late trains exasperate commuters more than occasional cancellations do.
column6: 比起偶发停运,火车频繁晚点更令通勤者恼火。

column3: a. 令人气馁的
column5: The discouraging sales figures pushed the team to redesign the entire campaign.
column6: 令人泄气的销售数据促使团队重新设计整个营销方案。

column3: a. 范畴的, 绝对的, 明确的
column5: The minister issued a categorical denial of any involvement in the contract scandal.
column6: 部长断然否认与合同丑闻有任何牵连。

column3: a. 自然的, 自然主义的
column5: The play's naturalistic dialogue makes the family arguments uncomfortably real.
column6: 这部剧自然写实的对白让家庭争吵显得真实得令人不安。

column3: a. 教条的, 武断的
column5: Good scientists stay curious rather than dogmatic about their favorite theories.
column6: 优秀科学家对心仪理论保持好奇,不固守教条。

column3: vi. 畏缩, 退缩, 抖缩
column5: The loud thunder made the puppy cower under the sofa.
column6: 隆隆雷声吓得小狗蜷缩到沙发底下。

column3: n. 约束, 约定, 契约;订定, 规定, 条款
column5: The grant came with one stipulation: the research data must be published openly.
column6: 这笔拨款附带一个条件:研究数据必须公开。
